reason: A DSH shell-provider plugin that replaces the local bash executor to preserve raw subprocess output and automatically decode mixed or non-UTF-8 encodings, primarily addressing Windows/WSL terminal乱码.

summaries.zh: 通过替换 DSH 的 bash 执行器，保留子进程原始输出并自动识别 UTF-16LE、UTF-8、GBK 等编码，以减少 Windows/WSL 终端乱码。
summaries.en: Replaces the DSH bash executor to preserve raw subprocess output and detect encodings such as UTF-16LE, UTF-8, and GBK for more reliable Windows and WSL terminal text.

capabilities: Spawns bash subprocesses and captures raw stdout and stderr bytes
Automatically detects and decodes UTF-16LE, UTF-8, GBK, and GB18030 output
Supports command timeouts, output limits, stdin, and background process lifecycles
Reads selected environment and sandbox configuration for subprocess execution
